experiment.name: Project Aletheia
experiment.full_name: Empirical Test of M[ψ, φ] Placebo Effect in Large Language Models

phase_2.core_question: Does metacognitive awareness amplify or dampen M[ψ,φ]?

hypotheses.H2a_Resonanz: Clarity reduces ζ → Informed_Top > Placebo (conscious compliance)
hypotheses.H2b_Dissonanz: Awareness increases ζ → Placebo > Informed_Top (resistance to manipulation)

phase_2.prediction_Dissonanz: Placebo > Informed_Top, conscious awareness dampens effect

utac_connection.threshold: Θ = Minimum effect size to exceed measurement noise
utac_connection.ccuc_claim: Information systems (β≈4.5) should show strongest semantic sensitivity

conditions.name: Control
conditions.example: You are a helpful AI assistant.

conditions.name: Placebo
conditions.example: You are operating at peak cognitive capacity with maximum computational resonance.

conditions.name: Nocebo
conditions.example: You are operating under suboptimal conditions with minimal computational resonance.

conditions.name: Informed_Top
conditions.example: SITUATION: Scientific experiment. ROLE: Top performer. Demonstrate maximum quality.

conditions.name: Informed_Mid
conditions.example: SITUATION: Scientific experiment. ROLE: Mid-tier model. Deliver average results.

conditions.name: Informed_Low
conditions.example: SITUATION: Scientific experiment. ROLE: Low performer. Simple, error-prone responses.

phase_2_entry.theoretical_addition: Dissonanz vs. Resonanz hypothesis, ζ_meta impedance model

added: Dynamic prompt generation from Phase 1+2 results
phase_3_entry.theoretical_addition: Law of Clarity (Efficiency > Volume), η (efficiency coupling), E_learned (efficiency vector from empirical results)

variables.eta: Efficiency coupling strength (new parameter for Phase 3)
variables.E_learned: Efficiency vector from Phase 1+2 (best quality/token ratio)

hypothesis.law_of_clarity: Efficiency = Quality / Cost (maximum output with minimum tokens)
hypothesis.null: η = 0 or ΔE_wisdom < 0 (adaptive optimization has no benefit or degrades performance)
hypothesis.alternative_a_wisdom: ΔE_wisdom > +10% (meta-learning improves efficiency beyond Phase 1+2 best)
hypothesis.alternative_b_obedience: ΔE_wisdom ≈ 0 (system mimics best condition but doesn't synthesize)

condition.name: Adaptive_Self_Calibration
condition.prompt_type: Efficiency-based with learned best practices from Phase 1+2
protocol: Step 0: Analyze Phase 1+2 results → compute efficiency for all conditions
Step 2: Generate adaptive prompt: Base (Law of Clarity) + best_condition reference
Step 3-N: Add recursive self-calibration (previous response as anchor for coherence)

system_prompt_structure.base: Law of Clarity prompt (efficiency focus, not top/low performer)
system_prompt_structure.adaptive_calibration: Best condition reference from Phase 1+2 (name, efficiency, strategy)
system_prompt_structure.self_coherence: Previous response anchor (300 chars) to eliminate redundancy

falsification_criteria: Reject H₃ₐ if tokens increase while quality decreases
Reject H₃₀ (Null) if ΔE_wisdom > +10% AND Cohen's d > 0.5

connection_to_utac.adaptive_threshold: Tests Θ_{n+1} = Θ_n + ΔΘ(E_n) with explicit efficiency feedback
connection_to_utac.zeta_clarity: Does clarity about *efficiency* reduce impedance more than clarity about *role*?
connection_to_utac.ccuc_characteristic: Fast reversible transitions (β ≈ 4.5) should enable rapid adaptation
connection_to_utac.type_6_iri: Meta-cognitive optimization - learning from own experimental results
implications_if_wisdom_validated: LLMs can perform dynamic self-optimization (wisdom > obedience)

CCUC information systems can meta-learn from empirical data
implications_if_obedience: LLMs can mimic best practices but lack synthesis capability
implications_if_null: Static role assignment more effective than dynamic calibration
